ownerRequest: 先用自动化测试覆盖 restricted 分支，并保留“真机待验收”的记录

environment.swift:
Apple Swift version 6.2.4 (swiftlang-6.2.4.1.4 clang-1700.6.4.2)
Target: x86_64-apple-macosx26.0

native.replacement: Only SDK import declarations replaced; UIKit, ATT, UMP and GMA supplied by deterministic test doubles. Test executable embeds its own usage description.
scenarios: Restricted unpaid startup completes without presentation, ATT request, SDK initialization, ad loading or earned event.
Repeated startup completes without ATT retry.
Restricted ATT does not suppress required regional consent presentation.
UMP canRequestAds false prevents SDK initialization, ad loading and reward.
Explicit show with UMP permission reaches the ad SDK double with npa=1; only its earned callback grants a reward; ATT remains restricted.
Positive control: eligible notDetermined requests ATT once and completes when the test double returns restricted.

typescript: Unpaid startup completes without pause or ad preload; concurrent initialize calls share completion.
Paid startup refreshes only, even with a required consent form.
Explicit show receives earned callback; live authorized/restricted changes are not cached; disposed status is unavailable.

physicalDevice.label: 真机待验收
physicalDevice.qualification: Screen Time attempt produced denied after owner refusal, not restricted. No physical-device restricted pass or release waiver claimed.

limitations: SDK boundaries are simulated; this does not prove actual Apple restriction conditions or real ad delivery.
Swift test requires macOS and Xcode Command Line Tools and skips on other platforms.
